_about: Drive and servo data for the Triceratops build model. Maker figures come from the T. rex study's catalog hardware/trex_form_study/designlab/data/actuators.json (maker datasheets read 7 Nov 2026) as summarised in hardware/triceratops_kickoff/PARTS_PREMIUM.md sections 2.1, 2.5 and 2.8 (18 Nov 2026). Nothing here is measured on this project's parts. 'armature_kgm2' is the catalog's estimate (T. rex rule A7: 2.5e-6 kg m^2 x (D / 55 mm)^4 x gear^2), reflected to the drive output; the maker's published inertia figures are ambiguous about the side of the gearbox (T. rex MAKER_QUESTIONS.md, question 1). 'thermal_eq_nm' is the maker's temperature-rise table value (90 min, motor reaching 100 C, open air). Rule set: design peak <= 0.70 x peak_nm; continuous <= thermal_eq_nm; speed <= 0.70 x no-load at 42 V for 48 V drives, and <= rated_rpm (83) for the 24 V X4 run above its rating (PARTS_PREMIUM.md F1, reseller text quoting the maker, to confirm).
